content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Bitcoin payment

This is a complete digital commerce stack designed for creators in regions where traditional payment platforms fail. It combines free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase with NOWPayments for crypto processing. The result? A fully operational online store that accepts Bitcoin and 300+ cryptocurrencies. No platform fees. No KYC. No buyer accounts required. You own the entire stack after deployment. This is not a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure built to withstand payment rejection, currency collapse, and financial isolation.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting (free). Backend logic is handled via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script (free). Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets (free). Files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 (free). NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain and triggers instant product delivery. The system is automated, secure, and decentralized. No single point of failure. No platform dependence. You control every component.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are unavailable or restricted. If you’ve been locked out of conventional payment platforms, this stack gives you infrastructure sovereignty. It’s also for creators who want to retain more revenue—NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction, compared to Gumroad’s 10%. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, you retain $921 more per month.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction—Gumroad charges 10%. Retain $921 more per month at 100 sales.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles backend logic and file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets stores order data. NOWPayments processes crypto payments and triggers delivery via webhook. The stack is modular—you can swap components as needed. For example, use BSC, Solana, or TRON networks for transaction fees under $0.10. Every component is free or low-cost, and you own the entire system after deployment.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a fully deployed solution in 48 hours. Alternatively, purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all 6 blueprints and 7 templates to build your own stack. Follow the step-by-step guides in the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) to deploy manually. Each option gives you lifetime access to infrastructure you own. No subscriptions. No platform dependence. Just sovereign commerce.

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. This setup eliminates platform fees and restrictions. For example, NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction, compared to Gumroad’s 10%. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, you retain $921 more per month. The stack is automated, secure, and fully owned by you.

Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to purchase. This kit is designed for creators who want to own their infrastructure, avoid platform fees, and sell globally without restrictions.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 2. Set up backend logic: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 3. Configure order storage: Supabase or Google Sheets. 4. Enable file delivery: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 5. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing. 6. Test end-to-end: Ensure payment triggers file delivery. 7. Deploy your stack and load your products. 8. Purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all blueprints and templates.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) are deployed for you in 48 hours. Alternatively, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes step-by-step guides and templates for self-deployment.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, USDT, and Solana. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON—all under $0.10 per transaction.
Do I need to pay recurring fees?

No. The stack uses free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase. NOWPayments charges a one-time 0.5% fee per transaction. You own the infrastructure after deployment—no subscriptions.
How is file delivery secured?

File delivery is triggered automatically via webhook once payment is verified on-chain. Files are stored securely in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and access is granted only after payment confirmation.
Can I scale this stack as my business grows?

Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for email deliverability. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes a scaling playbook to handle increased traffic and transactions.
